svg.title: Independent reliability control planes
svg.desc: Four layers separate model behavior from application policy, OpenShift enforcement, and accountable human governance.
svg.text: No single control makes an agent reliable

g.text: Reason over bounded evidence; return a recommendation; never grant authority
Guardrails, tool allowlist, required evidence, retry budget, explicit degraded behavior
Service account, RBAC, namespace isolation, Secrets, NetworkPolicy, deployment health
Approval, operational ownership, incident response, audit, and release acceptance
